She was not discovered until the new owners of the home found her, and luckily, it was not too late. Massachusetts Dog Rescue Seeks Community Support for New Foster Dogs
Sandy Paws Rescue Inc., a volunteer-run nonprofit organization based in Massachusetts, is reaching out to the community for urgent assistance to feed their foster dogs. With a new group of rescue pups arriving later this week, the organization has completely depleted their food supply and is asking for donations to help meet this immediate need. The rescue organization recently issued an appeal on social media stating, "We are OUT of food for incoming foster pups, with the next group heading to MA later this week!" They specifically mentioned that small and medium-sized bags of dog food are most needed at this time. Sandy Paws has created an Amazon wishlist where supporters can purchase food that will be delivered directly to their foster pickup location. This system ensures that donations efficiently reach the dogs who need them most without requiring additional transportation or coordination.
